newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Missing Nigerian plane crashed, no survivors.
newsitem.headline: Missing Nigerian plane crashed, no survivors.

text.p: A Nigerian airliner missing since Thursday evening has crashed with no survivors, an aviation ministry official said on Friday.
"All the 141 people that were on the plane died," she said, adding that Aviation Minister Air Commodore Ita Udo-Imeh had gone to the crash site.

Flight ADC086, a Boeing 727 operated by Aviation Development Company, a privately owned airline, lost contact with the control tower in Lagos at 5 p.m. (1600 GMT) on Thursday minutes before it was due to land.
"The details of where the crash happened and all that will be given after the ministry has assessed the situation," the aviation ministry official said.
The plane was flying from the southeastern oil city of Port Harcourt to Lagos with 132 passengers and nine crew members.
Witnesses said scores of relatives of people believed to have been on board had assembled at the offices of the airport authority and many were weeping.
